dataList.content:
<color=#4e3076>Come back, Heath.</color>
<color=#4e3076>归来吧，希斯。</color>

<color=#4e3076>To the manor where the last vestiges of its beauty remain in its violet flowers.</color>
<color=#4e3076>回归那唯余紫色花朵仍然绚烂的宅邸吧。</color>

<color=#4e3076>To the manor where its storm-broken breach
has siphoned all that was once warm.</color>
<color=#4e3076>回归那因暴雨侵入而墙间龟裂，温暖全然消散的宅邸吧。</color>

<color=#4e3076>To the manor that gave you not only life...
but also scorn and desolation.</color>
<color=#4e3076>回归那哺育你成长，又以污蔑与崩溃代偿的宅邸吧。</color>

<color=#4e3076>To the manor where your place was the frozen corner
that couldn't be further from the hearth.</color>
<color=#4e3076>回归那并非暖炉，而仅有冰冷一隅供你栖息的宅邸吧。</color>

<color=#4e3076>Return from the moors.</color>
<color=#4e3076>从荒野里归来吧。</color>

<color=#4e3076>It’s time for you to come home.</color>
<color=#4e3076>是时候回家啦。</color>

<So this is what T Corp.’s Nest looks like...>
<这里就是T公司的巢吗……>
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
We had surprisingly little trouble making it past the Nest’s borders. I guess my concerns were unfounded.
似乎是在诉说我的杞人忧天一般，我们很轻松地跨越了巢的边界。

Well... Somehow, we made it through this Nest checkpoint without any trouble.
不过……值得庆幸的是这次进巢的入境检查平安无事地结束了。

Ahem, ahem...! 'Tis nothing! Forsooth, such wild compliments are unnecessary, says I~
咳，嗯哼……这等小事……嗯哼！无须对吾褒奖至此~

But... we... didn't say anything...?
没有人在夸你……

She's grown so much...
她真的长大了啊……

Everyone seems awfully relaxed for having just entered a different Nest.
进入巢后，所有人的紧张感似乎都被缓解了……

I guess everyone's gotten used to this by now. Humdrum, routine... I guess they'd be the words to describe the general sentiment among the Sinners.
可能大家也快习惯了吧？一如既往的、日常般的……我想这样的词汇恰好能形容这种感觉。

Except for one, that is.
除了一个人以外。

<We’re headed to this place called ‘Wuthering Heights’ next, right?>
<下一个目的地是名为呼啸山庄的宅邸吧？>

I could tell from Heathcliff's glum expression that his mind was weighed down by all kinds of complicated concerns.
希斯克利夫阴沉的表情看上去十分复杂。

Huh? Uh… yeah.
啊？啊……没错。

Though his eyes were staring at the moving scenery past the windows, his mind was affixed on something that his eyes couldn't see. Something that lay beyond the building walls.
虽然他现在正眺望着窗外的景色，但我能感觉到他的思绪在眼中不断翻涌，萦绕在远方的某处。

'Wuthering' Heights...
呼啸……山庄吗……

That manor must’ve been built on one windy hill, huh?
听起来像是一幢被狂风吹拂的屋子啊？

Yeah. Bloody 'wuthering', like its namesake.
嗯，那间宅邸周围的风刮得真他妈够呛。

... Not a single corner of that place gave any comfort.
……那是个不存在片隅温暖的地方。

Heathcliff’s voice carried an unusually dark tone. The other Sinners on the bus noticed this and began chatting him up.
希斯克利夫的声音带着平时无法听到的阴沉感，对此巴士的罪人们也有了些许反应。

A return to one’s homeland must bring forth quite the tangled mass of emotions.
身归故乡，一定心绪交杂吧。

Homeland? Well...
故乡，吗……

I wasn’t born here, I was raised here… I suppose that could still count as a ‘homeland’, in a way.
这里并不是我出生的地方，只是我长大的地方……不过，你说是故乡的话那就算是吧。

But it doesn’t conjure in me the same feeling that a ‘homeland’ is supposed to.
但是我心中的情感并不是一般人提起故乡时会浮现出的那种。

... That is to say...?
……也就是说？

You’ve no idea how many times I imagined it, played it out in my head. Returning to that bloody manor, smashing every little thing in that place to bits until there is nothing left...
我在脑海里想象过几千次了。我会回到那个……天杀的家里……然后将它尽数破坏，什么都不剩……

Okay, so you’ll smash everything to bits. Then what?
尽数破坏之后，你又准备做什么呢？

Did you really learn nothing from watching what I went through at the Lake?
你看看我，你还没开窍吗？

... I did learn something.
……我明白了一件事。

If I ever lose the plot and push myself to the brink of no return, I trust that one of you louts will pull me right out of it.
总而言之，在我失控崩溃之前，我相信你们之中肯定有人会想办法拉我一把。

... Are you giving us permission to beat the sense back into you?
……怎么，是让我们把你打一顿再拉回来的意思吗？

Yeah. If that’s what it takes. 
就算是把我打一顿。如果有这种必要的话。

Interesting. How far are we allowed to go with bodily harm? Amputation? Nerve mutilation?
能做到什么程度？比如切断肢体和损伤神经组织……

Maybe we can at least smack his head really hard?
狠狠地给你脑袋上来一下也是可以的吧？

All right, you cheeky bastards...
不是，你丫……

Seriously, this ain't an invitation to use me as your emotional punching bag. I’m not in the mood to—
我不是让你们在我身上发泄长久以来的积怨。我在很严肃地……

Still, I think your present self can do this, Heathcliff.
不过，我觉得现在的希斯克利夫先生能做得很好。

Huh? What do you mean my ‘present self’?
你说什么，“现在”是什么意思？

Heathcliff, your present self is… deprived. You're poor, and you don’t have anything left...
现在的希斯克利夫先生非常贫乏，身上一无所有。

What? ‘Poor’…?
啊？贫乏……？

Right, now you’re skipping past the pleasantries and going straight into personal insults, yeah? I’m—
你终于动真格地来挑衅了是吧？我……

Oh, ha ha… I think you took my words the wrong way.
啊，哈哈……不，你好像有些误会。

Hong Lu is far from the most talkative Sinner, but when he does speak… he usually has something insightful to say.
虽然鸿璐平时并不健谈，但他偶尔也会说出一些意味深长的话来。

Though since he never says it in a way that’s immediately obvious, his words are very prone to misunderstandings…
虽然在大部分情况下，由于他那种会招致误会的说话方式，其他人并不能真正理解他想说什么……

In a way, we’re all ‘deprived’... and that can change a lot of things. Maybe there are things that we can understand only when we’re left with nothing.
我们所有人，都很贫乏。所以与以前相比有很大不同。也许我们只有在一无所有的时候，才能注意到一些以前注意不到的东西。

Doth that poverty explain our current unsightly lack of colorfulness…?
因为贫乏……吾等便必须一直保持此等阴暗的色彩吗？

Don Quixote looked mournfully at everything around her, then at herself. She sounded like she was about to cry.
堂吉诃德泪眼汪汪地反复对比着窗外的景象、巴士的样子以及自身的姿态。

Everything had been drained of color since the moment we entered T Corp. through the Backstreets.
自从后巷进入T公司以来，万千色彩都褪去了。

It feels like even more of our colors have been taken away since then.
也许……比起我们刚进入时褪得更为厉害。

I was wondering when we’d bring that up~
我就在想什么时候才能说起这件事~

Haah, maybe we’ll get our colors back soon...
哈，我们到底要保持这种颜色到什么时候？

… or so I thought, like ten hours ago...
就在十小时前我还在想这事……

Are we gonna be colorless forever? Are we gonna be stuck in this gloomy hue for the rest of our lives? Seriously, nothing looks tasty in this sepia hue… I'm starting to lose even my will to live...
无论走到哪里色彩都没有恢复原状！难道我们要保持一辈子这样吗？这样下去食欲也会不振的，还有什么活下去的意义呢……

Everything’s in that sickly brown hue! Guys, even meat looks downright rotten in this color!
就算吃肉！肉啊！看上去也像是腐烂了一样！

... That's a bit of an overreaction, isn't it?
……话题是不是有点跳得太快了？

Oh, and what about those guys? They’ve got color in their clothes!
不过那边的人……？衣服上有颜色吧！

With an annoyed look, Rodya gestured toward the people outside the bus.
罗佳气鼓鼓地指向了窗外。

A sufficient amount of payment must be made in order to retrieve your colors. It must be emphasized that this question has been repeatedly answered on twenty-three separate occasions.
我已经向不同的人回答共计二十三次了，重获色彩需要支付相应的金额。

Well, let me have a gander. His coat, his trousers...
要让颜色恢复到那种程度的话……大衣和……裤子……

Hah, That bloke’s not even that loaded. He’s only trying to come off as though he is. Real toffs spare no cash to get every single colour back, even to their trivial trinkets like the rims of their glasses.
哈，那个蠢货明明没几个钱还要装阔气。真正的有钱人连眼镜框这种装饰的颜色也会买回来。

Did you also have to live without color when you lived here, Heathcliff?
希斯克利夫先生在这生活的时候也一直看不到色彩吗？

No. The manor had some colour, yeah. … Though it was still far from vibrant.
不，宅邸在某种程度上是个例外。……不过那里也依旧死气沉沉。

Agreed. This is the color of shit. Blood should've remained red.
同意。死气。至少把血的颜色还回来啊。

That poor sod’s going to get himself jumped wanderin’ about with that look. That's just enough colour to invite the bandits, but not enough to keep ‘em away.
不过那家伙啊……带着那种半吊子的颜色到处转悠的话，正符合被人敲闷棍的状况啊。

Heathcliff’s predictions came true soon enough; several thieves surrounded the ‘bloke who’s only trying to come off as though he’s loaded’ and bashed him on the back of his head.
正如希斯克利夫所预言的那样，那个“没几个钱还装阔气”的人不久就被奇怪的男人们围住了，后脑挨了一记闷棍。

Fie, a bunch of shameless villains they are!
何等丧尽天良，寡廉鲜耻之人！

Preying on a weak civilian like a pack of hyenas...!
怎能对独行的无辜市民以多欺少！

Are they... what you would call a 'gang'?
黑帮……应该如此称呼他们吗？

Tsk, the gangs of T Corp. have certainly seen better days. I wouldn’t even call ‘em a gang… they’re just lowlives running out of ‘time’.
啧，真是世风日下。那种人才不算黑帮，只是一群时间不够的下等人而已。

The last time I was here, scum like ‘em couldn't even dare to infest the streets so brazenly.
我离开这里的时候，那种垃圾货色是不敢这么大摇大摆地四处游走的。

<… There are gangs that aren’t scummy?>
<黑帮也分垃圾和不垃圾的吗？>

‘Course! The gang I was in would never dogpile on some poor, unarmed bloke like that.
当然！我曾经待的黑帮才不会一窝蜂地欺负那种手无寸铁的弱者！

Charon wants to vroom-vroom. Can’t vroom-vroom with a roadblock.
卡戎，想要嗖嗖开走。路被堵住了就不能布隆布隆。

Well, there isn’t much point in waiting for the situation to resolve itself.
嗯，在这里拖延也没有意义。

Vergilius finally spoke up after quietly listening in on our discussion for the last few minutes.
维吉里乌斯只是靠在椅子上，听着我们不停的讨论，最后发话了。

Take care of them before Don Quixote starts making a fuss about it.
在堂吉诃德闹腾起来之前下车，把这件事处理掉吧。

Ooh! An enactment of justice! I thank thee!
哦哦！此乃正义的体现！吾甚为感激！

He’s really starting to get the hang of this, huh...
真是的，向导先生看来也习惯了呢……

... Haah.
……哈啊。
